definitions.explanation: The number ten thousand. A key unit in Japanese counting, as large numbers are grouped by 万 (ten thousands) rather than thousands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a car for 1,000,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一千万人|いっせんまんにん}→一千万人：noentry⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: More than 10 million people live in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三万|さんまん}→三万：30467_sanman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦くれません→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五万|ごまん}→五万：30468_goman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: At this store, shipping is free if you buy 50,000 yen or more.

notes:
{万|まん} (ten thousand) is a fundamental unit in the Japanese number system. Large numbers are grouped by {万|まん}, not by thousands as in English.

COUNTING SYSTEM:
- ⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧: 10,000
- ⟦{十万|じゅうまん}→十万：30469_juuman⟧: 100,000
- ⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧: 1,000,000
- ⟦{千万|せんまん}→千万：28267_senman⟧: 10,000,000
- ⟦{一億|いちおく}→一億：08929_ichioku⟧: 100,000,000 (next unit)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{万一|まんいち}→万一：03740_manichi⟧: by any chance, in case of emergency
- ⟦{万全|ばんぜん}→万全：05932_banzen⟧: perfect, complete
- ⟦{万歳|ばんざい}→万歳：04339_banzai⟧: banzai, long live

CURRENCY NOTE:
⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧ is the 10,000-yen bill, the largest denomination in Japan.

TIP FOR LEARNERS:
When converting, remember: 1 million = 100{万|まん}, not 1000{万|まん}.
